source_name: Industry analyst estimate; Eldorado Gold ESTMA reports as reference point
notes: Eldorado Gold alone paid ~$30-50M/yr in Turkish taxes/royalties; total sector CIT scaled up ~10x to account for Eti Maden (boron), Park Holding (coal), Çayeli/Demir/Park Elektrik (copper/zinc), and dozens of smaller miners. 20% effective CIT.

USGS 2019 Minerals Yearbook for Turkey provides sector overview but not CIT split. Mining production value rising. Sector profitability moderate (Eti Maden state-owned boron monopoly profitable, gold miners profitable, base metals mixed).

source_name: Industry analyst estimate; TRY 83.1B mining production value (2020)
notes: Mining production value TRY 83.1B in 2020 (~$11.8B at avg 7.0 TRY/USD). 25% margin × 20% effective CIT = $0.6B; conservatively scaled to $0.35B because much of production value is intra-sector (cement raw materials etc.) and effective rates are lower with depreciation/incentives.

source_name: Industry analyst estimate; TRY 131.5B mining production value (2021)
notes: Mining production value TRY 131.5B in 2021 (~$14.8B at avg 8.9 TRY/USD), +58% YoY driven by commodity boom. Higher metals prices boost CIT. Eldorado Gold Turkish taxes also rose materially. Assumed effective CIT ~$0.6B.

source_name: Industry analyst estimate; Eldorado Gold ESTMA 2022 ($70M to Turkey); mining exports $6B
notes: Mining exports $6B in 2022; mining 1.36% of GDP. CIT rate raised to 23% (then 25% from 2023). Eldorado Gold alone paid $70M (taxes) to Turkish federal government in 2022. Total sector CIT scaled to ~$0.8B.

Higher oil prices boosted upstream profitability slightly. TPAO produced ~55,000 bpd. Upstream CIT ~$80M.

Lower oil prices. TPAO ~60-65,000 bpd. Excludes TUPRAS refining (TUPRAS 2019 net profit only TRY 526M).
